Adding isGenesisOwner gate to this GET would be proportionate but is not blocking given the scope. Not blocking — dev-only surface in a dev-mode server.
findings.note: nit: inaccurate comment + unauthenticated read endpoint in dev-only tool. Blast-radius: zero in runtime_target=local per ADR §0. No AC requires auth on this GET.

findings.issue: resetPack deletes departments BEFORE positions (line 554 before line 568). FK constraint position_tenant_id_department_id_fkey is RESTRICT (no CASCADE). If an extra department has positions, DELETE /api/departments would fail with FK violation. AC-9 test and R-1 test both use leaf depts created without positions — this masks the FK ordering bug for the case 'extra dept with children'.
findings.suggestion: resetPack should delete in dependency-safe reverse order: employees → positions → departments (or: delete positions first, then departments). Alternatively, the DELETE /api/departments handler could cascade deletes on positions. Not blocking — happy path AC-9 passes; the at-risk scenario (extra dept+positions) is not in any AC and is a dev-tool edge case. Should be addressed in a follow-up or noted in a code comment.
findings.note: nit: delete ordering bug masked by test isolation. Actual AC-9 scenario (extra dept, no children) passes. Production risk: zero (runtime_target=local, seed tooling only).

r6_409_leak_judgment.question: Does 409-with-body-{id} constitute tenant UUID information leak?
r6_409_leak_judgment.verdict: NOT a leak — auth gate precedes 409 branch
r6_409_leak_judgment.reasoning: POST /api/tenants handler: line 130 'if (!admin.isGenesisOwner) throw new HttpError(403, ...)' executes unconditionally after extractActor+loadAdminContext, BEFORE line 174 'if (insertConflict)'. An anonymous caller (or non-genesis-owner) receives 403 before the INSERT is attempted and before insertConflict is ever set. The privileged SELECT on line 181-190 (migrator pool BYPASSRLS) runs only inside the 'if (insertConflict)' block, which is only reached after the isGenesisOwner gate has passed. Blast-radius: zero for unauthenticated callers. For genesis-owner callers the UUID disclosure is intentional (they created the tenant). ADR §2.3 option C explicitly endorses this authority pattern.
r6_409_leak_judgment.adr_section: §2.3 option C — isGenesisOwner as bootstrap-class authority

get_tenants_slug_judgment.question: Is GET /api/tenants/:slug a dead/broken surface that must be removed or gated?
get_tenants_slug_judgment.verdict: LIVE surface (used by resetPack), RLS-correct for current pool (migrator BYPASSRLS), no auth-gate — nit in dev context
get_tenants_slug_judgment.reasoning: The endpoint is not dead — resetPack calls it at seed/importer.ts:536. It is RLS-correct because the migrator pool role BYPASSRLS (documented in code comment, line 626-630 of seed-write.ts). It has no auth-gate, making it an unauthenticated read of tenant UUID+slug. In runtime_target=local/dev-container (ADR §0, §8) this is acceptable: the entire server runs in X-Dev-User dev mode, there is no production tenant to protect. The T-0022 roadmap note in the code correctly identifies that a SECURITY DEFINER function will be needed when choros_app pool (NOBYPASSRLS) is adopted. Verdict: nit (inaccurate comment + no gate), not blocking. Does not require removal.
get_tenants_slug_judgment.adr_section: §0 runtime_target:local; T-0022 roadmap note in code
